# Abbreviated Stakeholder UAT Contingency

Use this instrument only if an intended SSET staff member becomes available
for approximately 10–15 minutes near the deadline. Use synthetic data only.
This is a supplementary feedback session, not permission to lower any KPI
threshold or replace the formal KPI-15 training instrument.

## Session metadata

| Field | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Date/time (UTC) |  |
| Participant role |  |
| Environment / classification |  |
| Candidate release full SHA |  |
| Facilitator role |  |
| Synthetic data/cohort reference |  |
| Session duration |  |

Do not record private identities, credentials, tokens, private URLs, or real
participant/staff data.

## Critical-path tasks

For every task, record exactly one result: `UNAIDED_PASS`, `ASSISTED_PASS`,
`FAIL`, or `NOT_RUN`. Record facilitator assistance explicitly, including a
prompt, navigation hint, correction, or explanation.

| # | Task | Result | Facilitator assistance / observation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Locate and import one synthetic project or batch |  |  |
| 2 | Interpret one warning versus one blocker |  |  |
| 3 | Perform or assess a correction, review, or approval action |  |  |
| 4 | Inspect publication preparation and the authorization boundary |  |  |
| 5 | Inspect or perform archive/unpublish behavior |  |  |
| 6 | Locate and interpret recovery/history guidance |  |  |

## Interpretation boundary

An abbreviated session is classified as:

`SUPPLEMENTARY_STAKEHOLDER_FEEDBACK`

It may add useful evidence about comprehension, usability concerns, and
follow-up needs. KPI-12 may only be marked passed if the actual executed
evidence satisfies the original KPI contract: all critical tasks completed,
average satisfaction at least 4/5, and minimal facilitator assistance. An
incomplete abbreviated session is not a KPI-12 pass.

This instrument does not measure KPI-01 staff-effort reduction and does not
replace the formal KPI-15 documentation-based intended-admin run, its at least
80% unaided completion rule, or institutional ownership transfer.
